management_steps.details: Clostridium tetani infection. Triad: rigidity (trismus/lockjaw, dysphagia), severe painful muscle spasms (laryngospasm, risus sardonicus, opisthotonos), and autonomic dysfunction (alternating tachycardia/bradycardia, hypertension/hypotension).

A (Intubate early to control airway spasm). B (Frequent suctioning for bronchial secretions). C (Autonomic stability: Magnesium Sulphate bolus and infusion). D (Benzodiazepines in large doses: up to 100mg/hr Diazepam).
Metronidazole IV (1st choice antibiotic). Anti-tetanus immunoglobulin (HTIG) 100-300 IU/kg IM. Clean and debride wounds thoroughly. Immunize (q10 yearly).
